title: The Dream That Took Another Road

shots.image: a stack of law books and legal notes on a desk, {WOMAN22} reading eagerly, side view

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I once dreamed of becoming a criminal lawyer.

shots.image: dreamlike scene: {WOMAN22} wearing a black lawyer's coat over her modest clothes standing in a grand wooden courtroom, soft glowing light, seen from behind
shots.motion: she steps forward confidently, soft dreamy glow
shots.sfx: quiet courtroom echo, footsteps, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I imagined studying law, standing in court and fighting for what was right.

shots.image: {WOMAN22} back at her desk hugging a law book and smiling, warm afternoon light, side view
shots.motion: she hugs the book, curtains move in the breeze

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It was a dream I genuinely loved.

shots.image: {AMMI_OLDER} sitting in the living room of {HOME} looking up kindly as {WOMAN22} enters, side view
shots.motion: the mother pats the sofa beside her

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But my mother had a different wish for my future.

shots.image: {AMMI_OLDER} and {WOMAN22} sitting together on the sofa, the mother holding her daughter's hand, side view
shots.sfx: soft room tone, clock ticking, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: She wanted me to pursue teaching.

shots.image: close view of {AMMI_OLDER} speaking gently to {WOMAN22}, seen over the daughter's shoulder

lines.speaker: AMMI
lines.text: Beta, I feel teaching would be a good path for you.

shots.image: {WOMAN22} nodding respectfully to her mother, seen from the side

lines.speaker: WOMAN
lines.text: Theek hai, Ammi. I'll give it my best.
lines.tts_text: ठीक है, अम्मी. I'll give it my best.

shots.image: {AMMI_OLDER} hugging {WOMAN22} warmly in the living room, seen from the side
shots.sfx: fabric rustle, birds outside, no music

shots.image: {WOMAN22} placing her law books neatly on a high shelf and taking down teaching books, seen from behind
shots.motion: she slides the law books onto the shelf and takes new books

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I chose to respect her decision and took another road.

shots.image: {WOMAN22} opening teaching books and a fresh lesson notebook at a sunny window desk, birds on the sill, side view
shots.motion: she writes the first line, birds hop

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I didn't know it then, but this new direction would eventually shape the person I would become.
